title: Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums
goal: Solve Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums: Explore the smallest pair sums from sorted rows with a min-heap, adding a row successor only after its current pair is removed.
strategy: Explore the smallest pair sums from sorted rows with a min-heap, adding a row successor only after its current pair is removed.
edgeCases: Fewer than k pairs may exist; equal sums can come from distinct index pairs.
inputRules: k must be a positive integer
keep arrays to 12 elements or fewer
